response.justification: Bogdan brings 13+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across web, backend, embedded and mobile, a CS degree, and one genuinely high-scale distributed systems stint (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby, millions of HTTP requests/sec with low-latency D services). However, the resume shows almost no evidence of the core of this role: experimentation frameworks, feature flighting, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, statistical analysis, or growth measurement. Seniority is also a step below the bar — titles top out at Senior/Staff in small-to-mid companies, with no demonstrated multi-team, multi-workstream architectural leadership at enterprise scale or documented cross-org influence. He would be a strong generalist hire but is a stretch for Principal/IC6 in growth and experimentation systems; worth a screening call only if the team is open to training up the experimentation domain.
strengths: 13+ years across many stacks (TypeScript, C/C++, Java, C#, D) with a CS degree
Real low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems experience at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby
Strong testing/craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source test tooling, teaching and workshops
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature flagging, or bias/rollout-risk experience shown
No telemetry, metrics platform, or statistical/data-analysis track record
Scope and seniority below Principal/IC6: no multi-team platform ownership or cross-org influence evidence

key_factors.factor: Depth and breadth of general engineering experience
Seniority/scope gap versus Principal IC6 expectations
